for_fable_end_review: A bare pilcrow, the pilcrow sign or 'paragraph mark' binds to RP (the primary witness); a WEB claim needs the WEB qualifier.
Rule 2 symmetry runs over RP starts only; WEB (tier 4, never drives a boundary) and SBL (span-scoped disclosure, sites at 220 of 437 verses) are exempt.
ABSENCE accepts 'paragraph start/break' as an RP absence while MARK_CLAIM does not take those words as a positive claim: an asymmetry to rule on.
The mention tier keeps breathings (strip_accents), so an unaccented run without breathings is a defect.
The normalizer judges each run book-wide, not against the cited verse; per-verse binding belongs to citation_sweep (absent).
MIN_LEN=2 skips one-letter Greek words.
U+037E in 5 SBLGNT verses is tolerated as a punctuation singleton in the witness guard; whether the substrate should normalize it upstream is a class question.
The ported K/Q editorial-note vector (Dan test section 4) flips polarity: the note route is closed in 1Cor, so it is RED.
The predecessor's Swete arm is not ported.
